Dockets
-------
ER26-3650-000        Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. submits tariff filing per 35.13(a)(2)(iii): 2026-08-28_Interconnection Reliability Requirements for Large Loads submitted on 8/28/2026 4:41:03 PM, Filing Type code: 10

Filing Party/Contacts:

Filing Party                             Signer (Representative)                  Other Contact (Principal)               
------------                             -----------------------                  -------------------------               
Steel Producers                          dex@smxblaw.com                          laura.baker@smxblaw.com                 

Basis for Intervening:
Nucor Corporation and Steel Dynamics, Inc. (collectively “Steel Producers”), on behalf of their respective steel mills located in the Midcontinent Independent System Operator, Inc. (“MISO”) footprint, respectfully file this motion to intervene. These industrial consumers of electricity have an interest that may be affected by the outcome of this proceeding. Accordingly, Steel Producers’ participation in this proceeding is in the public interest.
